verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core documented behavior is fully-managed incremental sync — connectors handle incremental syncs, schema changes, and capture deletes automatically without customer-managed pipelines (fivetran-docs-1, -18, -24, -35, -51), with explicit sync-mode and re-sync controls per connector (fivetran-docs-48). Community feedback corroborates that syncing is generally reliable and removes the burden of tracking API/schema changes (fivetran-comm-3, fivetran-comm-15), though one user noted an occasional full re-sync was needed as an exception (fivetran-comm-14), which doesn't contradict the standard incremental behavior. Missing for 10: deeper technical documentation on cursor/state mechanics (e.g., how state is stored/resumed) and more independent hands-on verification beyond anecdotal HN comments.
